description: Lexical flags for a human reviewer. A match is not an affirmative claim or a legal determination.

rules.safe_action: Request dated primary license/partnership receipt or rewrite as independent candidate
Separate prospect, outreach, letter of intent and signed contract; do not present as achieved
Require independent scientific and educational review plus limited scope
Require community-specific consent/credit, rights and power-sharing evidence

patterns: \b(?:live deployment|production ready|installed worldwide|available at every dome)\b
rules.safe_action: Request exact environment, tests and actual installation acceptance receipt

patterns: \b(?:guaranteed revenue|payback assured|investor returns|profitable from day one)\b
rules.safe_action: Label forecasts as conditional and disclose assumptions, costs and nonmonetized impact

patterns: \b(?:50 paying customers|validated customer demand|market proven|waitlist full)\b
rules.safe_action: Require consented records, date window, sample size and selection bias notes

patterns: \b(?:royalty free for all|unrestricted rights|public domain footage)\b
rules.safe_action: Verify content licenses, authorship, music and exhibition permissions
Specify test methods, age/audience scope and independent venue safety review

patterns: \b(?:student data collected|automatic child profiles|tracked student identities)\b
rules.safe_action: Block unapproved child-data intake and route for privacy review

false_positive_handling: Check whether source explicitly negates or quotes the phrase as prohibited
Disentangle fiction, simulation, roadmap, third-party claims and real deployment
Require primary evidence; do not treat grep coverage as factual certification
Keep dissent and original quote with attribution and review scope
No automatic public release, partner contact, de-identification claim or code execution
strongest_safe_claim: Planetarium Revival is an exploratory simulation and audience-discovery workstream; no production installations, partners, financial results, or cultural permissions are represented by this fixture.
